title: A deferred caption for a pending media message is never dropped if the pending message is deleted or cancelled
trigger: Send a photo, press Up to edit the caption while it is uploading, then delete/cancel the pending message so no updateMessageSendSucceeded or Failed arrives for it.
effect: The DeferredCaption stays in session.messages.deferred_captions for the life of the account (only run_deferred_caption on a send outcome removes it). Small leak; no wrong send since temp ids are not reused.
fix: Drop deferred captions in the message-delete reducer, or keep the caption on the pending message row as a PendingSend::CaptionEdited variant so it dies with the row.

title: Two separate adjacent quotes become one quote after markup round trip
trigger: Quote line 1 and quote line 2 as two separate block quotes on adjacent lines, then send or reopen the draft.
effect: The markup writes '> a\n> b' and push_quote_line (markup_parser.rs:167) merges consecutive quote lines, so the distinct quote spans are merged; to_final_markup sees from_markup(markup) != self and falls back to the same text.
fix: Separate adjacent quotes need an explicit marker in markup, or normalize them to one in the doc.

title: close_open_chat / send_open_chat / close_chat_window register a pending request and do not take it when the send fails
trigger: closeChat or openChat send returns Err
effect: session.request(..) entry stays in requests.pending for the life of the session (every other site calls requests.take(extra)); chat_window.rs:107, composer.rs:349 and :360
fix: Use the send-or-take helper (send_json_request) in these three sites.

title: One session-wide mention_search is searched against session.open_chat, shared by main and chat-window composers
trigger: Type '@x' in a chat window composer while the main window shows another group or no chat
effect: search_mentions uses session.open_chat (the main window's chat unless the caller entered the window view) and stores a single Option, so a window can show or clear the other window's suggestions
fix: Key the search by (window, chat) or store it in the window's ChatUi.

title: One shared emoji.failed bool is cleared by any emoji_set_request, hiding an earlier failure
trigger: A status change send fails (failed=true, status_note set), then another unrelated emoji pack request is sent.
effect: failed is reset to false by the unrelated request; the stage of the failed action is lost (status_note remains).
fix: Per-action Fetch<()> instead of a shared failed flag.

title: ensure_emoji_pack_covers marks covers requested before ensure_media_files succeeds
trigger: Open the pack browser when the media request send fails.
effect: Those set covers are never requested again.
fix: Insert into covers_requested only after the download request went out.

title: delete_selected ignores can_be_deleted_for_all_users that delete_confirmed honors
trigger: Select several own old messages in a basic group and Delete for everyone
effect: revoke is sent as true when all are outgoing; TDLib refuses the ones past the window and the whole batch fails
fix: Pass per-message can_revoke into the selection delete

title: view_shown_trending_stickers clears the unread dots (is_viewed = true) before the request and does not undo them if the send fails; ensure_manager_covers marks covers_requested before ensure_media_files
trigger: Open Trending while the view request cannot be sent / covers fail to request.
effect: Unread dots are gone but TDLib never learns they were viewed; covers never retried while the box stays open.
fix: Mark viewed/requested only after the send succeeds.

title: fetch_attached_sticker_sets replaces sticker_set_view with a loading placeholder, overwriting any open set box
trigger: Open a sticker set box, then choose Attached Stickers in the media viewer menu.
effect: The open set view is replaced by an empty set-0 view; the set the user was viewing is gone.
fix: Keep attached lookup as its own stage that opens the set view only on its answer.

title: Composer suggestions waiting for the installed sets stay in suggest_waiting_for_sets when the sets request fails
trigger: Sticker suggest mode 'installed only' with installed sets not loaded; getInstalledStickerSets fails.
effect: The GetInstalledStickerSets error path sets failed but not the waiting flag; composer_suggestions_idle stays false, so every typed emoji re-sends the sets request.
fix: enum Suggest { Idle, WaitingForSets{emoji}, Asking{emoji, request}, Showing{emoji} } cleared on error.

title: Swept searchEmojis requests free their slot without counting a failure
trigger: A searchEmojis request is dropped by the stale sweep (offline, TDLib never answers)
effect: retain_in_flight removes the entry but failures[query] is not incremented, so wants(query) stays true and the same query is asked again after every sweep instead of stopping after ATTEMPTS; failures also grows by one entry per failing query for the session
fix: Make retain_in_flight call failed() for each removed request

title: BoundedKeys clears the whole set at 16384 keys, which replays played effects and drops unplayed ones
trigger: A long session with many effect messages (or a busy chat history paged repeatedly) fills `watched`; the next insert clears it, and a history page that re-notes an incoming unread effect message makes it unwatched again, so it plays a second time. Filling `unwatched` first drops effects that never played.
effect: An effect replays on its own after scrolling back, or a sent or unread effect never plays.
fix: Evict the oldest keys (an LRU or a per-chat map dropped with the chat) instead of clearing everything.

title: Result bars of 0% show for a poll that is yet unsent or scheduled
trigger: View a scheduled or unsent poll in a chat
effect: poll_shows_results is true for any vote_restriction_reason, including YetUnsent and Scheduled, so zero-percent bars replace the option choices
fix: Show results only for reasons where the user can never vote and results exist (Closed, Country, Membership), not for YetUnsent/Scheduled.

title: quote_for resolves a selection by first occurrence of its text, not by where the user selected it
trigger: Select the second occurrence of a repeated phrase (e.g. the second 'ok.' or a repeated word) in a message and reply with a quote
effect: The quote's position points at the first occurrence, so the reply preview highlights and Telegram scrolls to the wrong part of the message
fix: Take the selection's byte start from the selection source and pass it to quote_for instead of searching for the string.

title: Chat-row animation map is keyed by bare chat id in app-wide FrameUi, never reset on account switch and never pruned
trigger: Open the chat list of account A, switch to account B that has a chat with the same id (same private user), or scroll a row away while its online state changes and back
effect: The online dot or badge animates from the other account's or the stale last-seen state instead of snapping on first sight; the map grows with every chat id ever drawn
fix: Move RowFxMap into OnScreen (replaced whole on a switch) keyed by ChatId, and drop entries for rows not drawn this frame.

title: Cache eviction of reply-bar fetches drops entries by smallest key, not by age, and a Loaded copy is never refreshed
trigger: Reply to an old message that was fetched with getMessage, then the original is edited (or others evict it)
effect: The bar keeps the stale text of a fetched copy (edits arrive only for rows in a history); eviction can remove another window's target and refetch
fix: Keep fetch order (insertion index) for eviction, and apply updateMessageContent to Loaded copies

title: last_callback_answer and last_login_url_info are single slots drained on poll, a second answer overwrites the first
trigger: Press two inline buttons (or two login buttons) before the poll drains the first answer
effect: The first button's toast, alert or URL is lost; login answer is not matched to the press that asked (login_url_request is also one slot)
fix: Queue answers keyed by request id, or key each by (chat, message, button)

title: Inline query pages are matched by (chat, bot) only, an older response lands on a newer query
trigger: Type an inline query, change the text quickly; the older answer returns last
effect: The picker shows results of the previous query text (acknowledged in the ponytail comment; the UI debounces)
fix: Put a query generation in BotsPurpose::GetInlineQueryResults and compare it with the slot

title: Set-edit counter and toast are shared by every edit of the set
trigger: Open an owned set, rename it, close the box, reopen it and start a second edit before the first one answers.
effect: The first answer decrements the new view's pending counter, so busy() is false while the second edit is still in flight; two answers also overwrite the single creator_note so one toast is lost.
fix: Hold the edits in flight as a set of RequestIds on the view (answers matched by id) and queue notes.

title: Emoji-set list failure is recorded only for the tab on screen at error time
trigger: Open Emoji Sets (Installed tab), switch to Trending before the installed list answers, let the installed request fail, switch back.
effect: emoji.failed is not set (tab differs) and no request is in flight, so Installed shows an empty loading state with no Retry until the tab is toggled again; emoji_set_request also clears the shared failed flag for unrelated requests.
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> (installed, trending, search) so each list owns its stage.

title: A mask list answer sent before a mutation can land after it and re-mark the list loaded
trigger: Manage Masks: open (list requested), remove a set; finish_mask_mutation clears installed_loaded, then the earlier getInstalledMaskSets answer arrives.
effect: accept_installed_mask_sets sets installed_loaded = true with the pre-mutation list, so the removed set shows as installed and nothing refetches.
fix: Tag list requests with a mutation generation, or hold installed/archived as Fetch<Vec<_>> invalidated by the mutation.

title: Message effect badge lookups only cover the main window's open chat
trigger: Open a chat with messages sent with effects in a chat window (not the main window's chat).
effect: message_effect_ids_in_view reads session.open_chat only, so the badge's effect description is not asked for in a chat window; the badge icon stays empty until the main window shows that chat.
fix: Collect effect ids over chats_shown() (all windows' views) instead of open_chat.

title: chat_preview_fetch is one slot not keyed by request: a late answer for an older preview overwrites the newer one
trigger: Peek chat A in the chat list, then peek chat B quickly (fetch_chat_preview_history sets the slot to None and sends B), then A's slower answer lands, then B's answer lands first in a reordered case.
effect: If B's answer arrives before A's, A's answer replaces it; the preview of B filters by chat_id and shows no rows and no retry.
fix: Store the slot as a Fetch<PreviewHistory> carrying the request id (or a map by chat) and apply only the answer whose id is current.

title: One shared StickerPanel.failed flag is cleared by any successful sticker fetch
trigger: The installed-sets fetch fails (failed=true); the user switches to Archived, which loads (accept_archived_sticker_sets sets failed=false).
effect: The installed tab's error banner disappears with nothing retried; back on the installed tab the empty list has no failure shown.
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> values.

title: GIF search results are kept under the current query, not the query the page answered
trigger: Search GIFs for 'cat', then 'dog'; the 'cat' page already sent but not cancelled (cancel_gif_search_requests drops only requests still pending in the registry).
effect: accept_gif_search_results calls searches_kept.keep(&gifs.search_query, ...) with the current query; if an old answer slips through it is stored and shown under 'dog'. Today cancellation makes this unlikely.
fix: Carry the query in StickersPurpose::GetGifSearchResults and compare it in the acceptor.

title: attachment_menu_toggled and data_sent are not matched to the flow that asked
trigger: Start adding bot B to the attachment menu from a link (awaiting_toggle set, toggle in flight) while a Remove from menu for bot A (from its profile) is also in flight, and A's answer lands first; or send data from mini app A, close it and open keyboard mini app B before A's answer lands.
effect: poll_mini_app_session ignores the bot id in Ok((_, added)) and takes awaiting_toggle on any toggle answer, so B launches before its own toggle answered and the wrong Added/Removed toast shows; data_sent carries no app at all, so B's flow reports A's result.
fix: Make each one-shot answer carry the request id (or bot id) it answers and take awaiting_toggle only when it matches, as attachment_menu_bot and found already do with the bot id.

title: A macOS text-replacement answer is matched to the composer by text prefix only, not by chat
trigger: macOS, text replacements on: type a shortcut and a space in chat A, and switch to chat B in the same window before NSSpellChecker answers, where B's draft starts with the same text.
effect: apply_system_text_replace (ui/composer_system_replace.rs) checks only that the composer's prefix equals Check::prefix, so the replacement is applied to chat B's draft.
fix: Carry the chat/topic key (AccountChat) in Check and apply the answer only while that chat's composer is the one shown.

title: Outgoing typing is keyed by chat only; sendChatAction is built with topic_id null and routed by whatever thread is open at send time
trigger: In a forum or a channel's comments, type into the composer in thread/topic A, then open topic B of the same chat (or go back to the chat) within 4 s.
effect: OutgoingTyping { chat_id, last_sent_ms } (connect/typing.rs) has no topic, so a thread change inside the same chat neither cancels A nor starts B (prev.chat_id == chat_id, inside the interval). The later chatActionCancel goes through thread_routed with the new thread's topic, so A keeps showing 'typing' until the server times it out, and the cancel goes to the wrong topic. For an admin in a channel's direct messages with a topic open, direct_routed leaves sendChatAction at topic null, so the typing does not reach that conversation.
fix: Key OutgoingTyping by (ChatId, Option<TopicId>), pass the topic into send_chat_action_kind, and cancel when that key changes.

title: Auction state fetch is three fields kept in step by hand (auction_request, auction_loading, auction_ready), plus UI pending_auction; the error arm clears loading without matching the request id
trigger: Open an auction from one gift link, then quickly another before the first getGiftAuctionState answers; the first request fails.
effect: The error arm (state/domains/payments/gift_market.rs:284-286) sets auction_loading = false for any AuctionState failure, not only when it matches market.auction_request. gift_market_frame_upkeep (ui/gift_market_ui.rs:231-243) then sees !loading with no ready id and drops pending_auction, so the second auction's box never opens even when its answer arrives.
fix: One AuctionFetch enum (Idle | Loading { request } | Ready { gift_id } | Failed) where the answer and the error both apply only when the request id matches.

title: Turning spell check on re-checks only the main window's composer
trigger: Open a chat in a separate chat window and type a misspelled word with spell check off; in the main window go to Settings > Chats and turn 'Check spelling' on.
effect: The switch handler runs sync_spellcheck on self.composer, the main window's slot only; the chat window's composer shows no underlines until its text changes (composer_ui.spelling is per window).
fix: Run the re-check in every window (in_every_window), as set_chat_prefs already does for the submit-on-Enter mode.

title: A poll task of a closed create dialog can finish a reopened dialog with the old name and username
trigger: Press Create, Cancel, reopen Create bot (another link/button) within 150 ms and press Create again
effect: The old poll task keeps its captured name/full and only checks bot_create_dialog.is_none(); with a new dialog present it keeps running and whichever poller sees created first closes the dialog, toasts and resolves the deep link with the old username
fix: Key the poller by a dialog token (like version) and stop when it differs, or drop polling for an answer-driven stage

title: Fill loop quits when no window can be updated, leaving the box 'Loading' with Save off
trigger: Open Edit bot, the opening window closes and the main window handle is unavailable (hidden/closed) before the texts arrive
effect: find_map returns None when neither window handle updates; 'filled != Some(false)' is true for None so the loop breaks and filled stays false forever; Save is disabled until the box is reopened
fix: Retry on None, or fill from the answer in the window that renders the box

title: Stale local error and sticky 'Saved' in the bot edit box
trigger: Save with a too-long name (local_error set), fix the text; or save once, then edit again
effect: local_error is cleared only by the next Save press, so the red error stays while the user fixes the field; edit.saved is a counter never reset by further edits, so 'Saved' keeps showing over unsaved changes
fix: Derive the status from the current field values and a SaveStage enum that goes back to Editing on change

title: 'Could not stop the reply' stays on screen while a retry is Stopping
trigger: Press Stop, request fails (stop_failed=true), press Stop again
effect: stop_failed is cleared only in finish_pending_bot_stop; a new StopPendingMessage request does not clear it, so the row shows 'Stopping...' and 'Could not stop the reply' together until the stop succeeds
fix: Fold into a StopStage enum so entering Stopping leaves Failed (connect/bots.rs:688 stop_pending_bot_message sets Stopping)

title: Verify box returns to the list as if done before TDLib answers
trigger: Pick a chat, press Verify/Remove while TDLib will reject it (not allowed, flood)
effect: submit_bot_verify returns true once the request is sent, so the box goes back to Pick and shows a 'Verifying...' toast; the failure only sets chat_action_error elsewhere and the row stays unverified with no per-box error
fix: Add a Step::Sending(chat) that leaves on the answer and shows the error in the box
